scene_rules.images_poses: stage-1 geogs_prep.py: copies of the cell images (TU1 campus images, train + test of the cell), TU1 cell scene cameras.bin / images.bin, empty points3D.bin, COLMAP text export, jbgs_calibration.json, split.json = TU1 cell split

surface.LoD2: inputs_prior cell LoD2 mesh, faces tri_type != 2 -> lod2.obj (6 decimals)
surface.ALS: inputs_prior cell ALS TIN, faces with >= 1 class-6 vertex (als_rule v1) -> als_building.obj (round-trip floats)

scene_rules.protection_cloud: 1,000,000 points uniform by area, face normals, numpy default_rng(0)
scene_rules.prior_depth: official LoD2Depth/main.py --generate_maps --z_offset 0 on every image of the cell scene
scene_rules.initial_points: official data/generate_pcd.py (fix1: 5 cm first-hit visibility), 100,000 samples, 2..15 observations, seeds 0; BASELINES als_pcd.py run_parallel (pieces broad phase, 24 workers) checked equal to the official function on the first 300 points
scene_rules.da3: FIX geogs_da3_fix.py --rule consec12 --save (DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE, official get_da3_depth_with_colmap.py inference, process_res 840, align_to_input_ext_scale, seed 0), on the sorted cell training views, ceil(N/12) consecutive balanced groups; GPU 1 while the queue holds (control/HOLD_GPU); shared by the ALS and LoD2 scenes of a cell

differences_from_previous: region = the expanded cell (prior faces in the expanded cell + 20 m); views = the cell views; 100,000 initial samples and 1,000,000 protection points over the whole cell surface (same numbers as the site runs, so fewer per m2); prior registration per inputs_prior
